items.text: Book at least 4 weeks ahead of any big event — results settle, bruising fades.
Skip blood thinners & NSAIDs (aspirin, ibuprofen, fish oil, vitamin E) for 2 weeks if you can.
No alcohol for 24 hours and no smoking for 48 hours before treatment.
Pause Retin-A two days before and after. No dental work within 4 weeks.
Eat a good breakfast and arrive with a clean, makeup-free face.
No workouts, yoga or massage for 24 hours — keep the product where we placed it.
No alcohol for 24 hours, no smoking for 48; both slow healing and invite bruising.
Prone to bruising? Arnica cream at the injection site helps.
Cleanse gently — no harsh scrubs or aggressive rubbing.
We see you again in 2 weeks. The follow-up is part of the treatment, and it's free.
